selection.summary: Patched internal/config/storage.go with three fixes for OCI backend config handling: (1) corrected mis-keyed default `store.oci.insecure` to `storage.oci.insecure` and added a 30s `storage.oci.poll_interval` default in setDefaults (h6); (2) added a `PollInterval` field (mapstructure `poll_interval`) to the OCI struct (h0/h8) so poll_interval is parsed and consumable by the OCI source (WithPollInterval in internal/storage/fs/oci/source.go, h1); (3) extended the OCI validation case (h5) to reject partially-specified authentication credentials with a clear 'both username and password need to be provided for oci authentication' error. Invalid repository references already fail via registry.ParseReference in validate (h5), covering the unknown:// case. Schema already includes bundles_directory (h8) and OCIAuthentication; testdata fixtures oci_provided.yml (h3) and oci_invalid_unexpected_repo.yml (h2) exercise these fields. Patch is unverified against tests.
